name: ScrollProgress
description: A thin bar showing how far the page, or a scrolling container, has been read.

target.description: A ref to a scrolling container to track. Omit to track the page.

position.description: Which edge the bar sits on.

color.description: Colour of the bar: any CSS colour or token.

thickness.description: Height of the bar in pixels.

requirements: role=progressbar with an accessible name and aria-valuemin 0, aria-valuemax 100 and aria-valuenow updated as the reader scrolls
Updates to aria-valuenow are throttled so assistive technology is not flooded
Never focusable and pointer-events none, so content under it stays usable
For reduced motion the bar still shows progress but moves instantly, with no easing
Forced-colors mode draws the bar in the system Highlight colour
The bar is supplementary: it must not be the only way to know where you are
screenReader: Announced as a progress bar with its percentage when the reader queries it
Not a live region: it does not interrupt reading

use_when: A scrolling panel where position matters
avoid_when: As a replacement for real navigation
anti_patterns: Using it as the only position cue
A thickness so large it covers a fixed header
